group90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Leila, had you finished the worksheet before the bell rang? I was still on the last question.
lines.pt: Leila, você tinha terminado a folha de exercícios antes de o sinal tocar? Eu ainda estava na última questão.

lines.en: Not quite. I had answered most questions, but I had not checked my calculations yet.
lines.pt: Não exatamente. Eu tinha respondido a maioria, mas ainda não tinha conferido meus cálculos.

lines.en: Had the teacher already collected the papers when you left the room?
lines.pt: A professora já tinha recolhido as provas quando você saiu da sala?

lines.en: No, she had gone to the office to print more copies, so we waited until she came back.
lines.pt: Não, ela tinha ido à sala dos professores imprimir mais cópias, então esperamos até ela voltar.

lines.en: Then I had time after all. By the time she returned, I had written the final answer twice.
lines.pt: Então eu tinha tempo, afinal. Quando ela voltou, eu já tinha escrito a resposta final duas vezes.

lines.en: You always rewrite things. Had you ever finished a test early before this year?
lines.pt: Você sempre reescreve tudo. Você já tinha terminado uma prova cedo antes deste ano?

lines.en: Never. Before I joined this class, I had never studied with a group, so everything felt new.
lines.pt: Nunca. Antes de entrar nesta turma, eu nunca tinha estudado em grupo, então tudo parecia novo.

lines.en: Same for me. After I had listened to Mr Harris for a week, I understood why the group works.
lines.pt: Comigo também. Depois de ouvir o Sr. Harris por uma semana, entendi por que o grupo funciona.

lines.en: He had warned us that the first month would be tough, but I did not believe him then.
lines.pt: Ele tinha nos avisado que o primeiro mês seria difícil, mas eu não acreditei nele na época.

lines.en: Honestly, I had expected much worse. When the bell rang today, I had already packed my bag.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, eu esperava algo bem pior. Quando o sinal tocou hoje, eu já tinha guardado minha mochila.

lines.en: Typical! Come on, let’s go before the cafeteria runs out of pizza again.
lines.pt: Típico! Vamos logo, antes que a lanchonete fique sem pizza de novo.

facts.label: Past perfect
facts.sub: Had you finished before the bell rang? I had already packed my bag.

facts.label: had + particípio
facts.sub: Use had + particípio para uma ação anterior a outra no passado: I had finished when the bell rang. Em português: “eu já tinha terminado”. Use already, before, by the time.

facts.label: Had you + particípio?
facts.sub: Pergunta: Had you finished the worksheet? Resposta curta: Yes, I had. No, I hadn’t. Sem did: não diga Did you had finished.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Had you finished? is a past perfect question.
Before, by the time and after often appear with the past perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Had you finished? is a past perfect question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Did you had finished?”. → Falso (We say Had you finished?)
Before, by the time and after often appear with the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Before the bell rang · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Dallas. The last lesson of the day is ending. Dora looks at the clock on the wall. Students whisper and pack their bags. Leila waits by the classroom door. A loud bell finally rings.

“Leila, had you finished the worksheet before the bell rang? I was still on the last question.” says Dora. “Not quite. I had answered most questions, but I had not checked my calculations yet.” says Leila. “Had the teacher already collected the papers when you left the room?” says Dora.
